engine.notes: Both organisations sit on the Ohio side; nothing in Covington or Newport could be verified. Go Bananas in Montgomery and the Funny Bone in Liberty Township are stand-up rooms.

entries.name: Improv Cincinnati at Clifton Comedy Theatre
entries.summary: Award-winning theatre company with its own underground black box on Ludlow Avenue, running 101 Fundamentals through advanced and elective seven-week classes, house teams, open jams, showcases and weekly shows.
entries.schedule: Intro workshops Sun Oct 4, 4-6 pm and Wed Oct 14, 7-9 pm, 2026; seven-week classes
signals: Own black box at 404 Ludlow Ave
Improv for business and private events
entries.reasons: A permanent theater with a levelled path to house teams, jams and weekly shows; the founding year is unstated and the show calendar renders only in the browser.

entries.name: OTRimprov
entries.summary: Long-form troupe founded in 2010 that performs a twice-monthly Show and Jam in Know Theatre's Underground, teaches a crash course and Levels 2 through 5, and produces the IF Cincy improv festival.
entries.schedule: Show and Jam at Know Theatre, Tuesdays Oct 6 and 20, 2026; classes $80-$150 when running
entries.reasons: Sixteen years and a festival give it standing, but it rents a stage rather than owning one, plays twice a month, and every listed class had ended at the time of reading.
